verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents a broad public REST API with an OpenAPI spec, OAuth 2.0, direct resource access, file downloads and rich-text content, plus an official CLI and MCP support for AI agents. Nothing states that the API matches everything the UI can do, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a per-feature endpoint mapping (e.g., Hill Charts, Everything Views, Client mode, templates, timesheets), and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
